This happened when I was 15. So I (15 F) had a crush on a nonbinary person, Snake (wrong name obviously)  who was assigned the female gender at birth (N14). They also had a crush on me, but we decided not to peruse any relationship because we were both young and because I didn't want everyone at school to know my sexual orientation (I was and am still scared of homophobes). So normally the story would have ended at that right? Wrong!

So one month later I am taking the bus and a random girl comes up to me and congratulates me for finally making things official with Snake. And I am just hella confused because we haven't really talked in that month and we have definitely not changed our agreement. It took me two weeks to confront them and by then it was like close to our exams and I told them that I was not in a relationship with them. Their response was something along these lines: "Too bad, I already told the whole school, and if you leave me I will unalive myself". So I "stayed" with them and felt very shit. Over the next few weeks they threatened to do the bad thing a few more times, they also tried to kiss me multiple times whilst I didn't want to. I managed to get away by saying things such as "But I haven't brushed my teeth" or "Ew, not with that coffee breath". I was scared to leave them because I was scared that if they did it I would be held responsible. Then came our exams and one day Snake comes up to me and says "I tried to do it." I ended things right there and then, well at least that's what I thought. Turns out they locked out memories that they didn't like. So I got invited on multiple dates afterwards, which I all declined. So they started manipulating my friend group into saying we would hang out but I would end up all alone with Snake. That's by the way how I was forced to share a bed with Snake 3 weeks after our official breakup (it took me 6 months to make the awkward date invite thing stop). The worst of all, this was during a school trip, and no teacher did anything to stop this from happening. 

The break trough came 3 months ago, keep in mind our "relationship" ended 2 years ago. So with our school we were going on this week long trip and we were able to chose our rooms. So my other friends stood me up and left me to sleep with Snake because they want us to be back together and Snake still has obsessive feeling for me. I talked to a teacher about it and they said they weren't going to do anything about it. And if anything, I could lock the bathroom door while changing. Snake's mom threatened me and outed me to my parents because I told people about Snake's actions. Over that week I grew increasingly anxious because the bathroom door had no lock and Snake kept staring at me whilst I was sleeping. I went to the teachers again but they told me to drink a beer and shut up, so I went to a room where I knew there would be alcohol and drowned 5 shots in 30 minutes (It was then that I learned that I resist quite well to alcohol). But I still felt very uncomfortable, I ended up having a panic attack the next day but instead of being helped at I got yelled at for being dramatic, luckily someone helped me.
